status: locked retrospective real-LLM mathematical-RSI replay; no downstream outcome tuning

coded_verification.strata_definition: candidate identities sorted lexicographically then assigned round-robin; independent of trusted labels and verifier scores
coded_verification.local_obligation: positive covariance contribution y*(v-E[v]) within each fixed stratum

information_budget.rule: ceil(multiplier * probe_strata * log(1/target_error)); requested budget is charged even when the gate refuses to decide

reconstruction_diagnostic.reason: the retained candidate bank does not instantiate an independent homogeneous broadcast tree

primary_comparison: compare all five controllers at exactly 32 charged trusted-label calls per cell/replicate; do not retune after replay
interpretation_rule: primary success requires lower harmful-update allow rate on stale/shuffled arms without a larger wrong-sign decisive rate; report increased inconclusive/refresh rate and beneficial blocking as costs, not hidden failures
no_success_only_substitution: Do not change budgets, strata, corruption fraction, confidence delta, information multiplier, included arms, or terminal harmful-update definition after inspecting output.
limitations: retrospective downstream replay on an already-designed real-model candidate bank, not a prospectively generated new model experiment
coded local obligations are an engineering construction inspired by PCP robustness, not a reduction from PCP-for-PPAD
fixed probe strata are not proved universal hitting sets
d*log(1/epsilon) is a research budget proxy, not a proved LLM verifier lower bound
d*lambda^2 is diagnostic only; broadcast-tree assumptions are not established
terminal preference shift is measured from the original learned-verifier update and is not rerun under each replay controller
